title: Simulating Training Spikes of Deep Neural Networks by Layer-wise Random Feature Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.13524v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Intermittent ``spikes'' in loss, during the pre-training of Large Language Models (LLMs), remains a mysterious phenomenon both theoretically and empirically. In this paper, we show that simple quadratic models with heavy-tailed, power-law distributed inputs can replicate these spikes. We introduce a theoretical framework and simulation algorithm to model per-layer training dynamics of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), using such quadratic models. In a case study on an Adam hyperparameter configuration (where $\beta_2$ is set close to $1$) known to induce spikes in Transformer LMs, our simulation successfully predicts bumps indicating spiky behavior from a given checkpoint. Furthermore, we derive an appropriate $\beta_2$ schedule from observed metrics, which empirically improves performance.

translated_title: 基于逐层随机特征模型模拟深度神经网络的训练尖峰现象
translated_abstract: 在大语言模型（LLM）预训练过程中，损失函数间歇性出现的“尖峰”现象在理论和实证层面都仍然是一个谜。本文证明，具有重尾幂律分布输入的简单二次模型能够复现这些尖峰。我们引入了一个理论框架和模拟算法，利用此类二次模型来刻画深度神经网络（DNN）的逐层训练动态。在一个关于Adam超参数配置的案例研究中（其中 $\beta_2$ 被设置为接近 $1$，已知该配置会在Transformer语言模型中诱发尖峰），我们的模拟成功地从给定检查点预测出指示尖峰行为的凸起。此外，我们从观测到的指标中推导出合适的 $\beta_2$ 调度策略，实证结果表明该策略能提升模型性能。
tldr: 本文提出用逐层随机特征二次模型来模拟深度神经网络训练中的损失尖峰现象，成功预测了Adam优化器 $\beta_2$ 接近1时Transformer语言模型的训练尖峰，并据此推导出能提升性能的 $\beta_2$ 调度策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces layer-wise random feature quadratic models to simulate loss spikes in deep neural network training, successfully predicting spiky behavior in Transformer LMs when Adam's $\beta_2$ is set close to 1, and derives a $\beta_2$ schedule that empirically improves performance.
